text:
anna-partnerships: Heads-up: Meeting with Delta SI next Tue about integrating our runtime with their orchestration product. Need alignment on SDK surfaces, auth flow, and joint blog timing. Can we sync on priorities?

mike-ecosystem: Quick Q — do we already have marketplace listing requirements? I can start gathering legal/contract needs.

jordi-product: We should provide a sample Helm chart and a minimal quickstart repo. Suggest 2-week pilot + sandbox env.

sara-eng: We have a lightweight adapter prototype but it lacks token rotation and metrics hooks. I'll prep a short spec and a PR.

anna-partnerships: @mike-ecosystem can you own marketplace checklist? @sara-eng will you own auth flow spec? Target joint announcement early May, so timeline is tight.

mike-ecosystem: @anna-partnerships yep I got this. Will map marketplace fields and onboarding steps. Any constraints from legal?

sara-eng: We use short-lived onboarding tokens (OIDC-backed). I'll add an SI flag for role scoping and a webhook for credential rotation. ETA EOD Thu for the spec.

jordi-product: I'll draft the external PR + FAQ. Need sample request/response for the adapter — @sara-eng can you drop a snippet?

sara-eng: snippet:
```
POST /v1/sessions
{
  "si_id": "delta-123",
  "ttl": 600
}
```
response includes short-lived token and metrics endpoint.

deploy-bot: Reminder: partnership-sync scheduled Thu 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent)

anna-partnerships: Action items recap: mike - marketplace checklist; sara - auth spec + snippet; jordi - PR & FAQ. 30m sync Thu 10:00 PT. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
